scope: Post-freeze descriptive review of the eight-question GRPO training pool; no validation or holdout label changes

records.question_condition: Jared counted 15% fewer cars than Ann; Jared counted 300; Ann counted seven more than Alfred.
records.diagnosis: The inverse of 15% fewer is division by 0.85, not multiplication by 1.15. Literal equations also yield fractional car counts, so a unique corrected integer answer is not justified by the wording.
records.action: Keep the official answer and all frozen pilot evidence. Report the item's actual exposure/rewards separately. Future cleanup must use a separate training-only audit, an explicit exclusion rule and a new frozen comparison; no silent relabeling or change between arms.

coverage_limit: This identifies a concrete issue in the tiny development pool, not a complete GSM8K label-quality estimate. Other records are not thereby certified clean.
